text: せっかく　ボスを　ごしょうたい　したのに　おまえの　せいで　だいなしだぜ！

structure.jp: せっかく　ボスを　ごしょうたい　したのに
structure.en: even though we went to the trouble of inviting the boss

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.span: ごしょうたい　したのに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', with a feeling of complaint that things did not turn out as they should. せっかく ごしょうたい したのに = 'even though we took the trouble to invite him'.

patterns.name: 〜のせいで
patterns.explanation: の せいで after a person or thing puts the blame for something bad on them. おまえの せいで = 'because of you, it's your fault'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes what you say onto the listener. だいなしだぜ = 'it's ruined, man!'.
